out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food on Display, Guards/Packaging
violations.observation: OBSERVED STEAM TABLE IN SEATING AREA (NOT IN USE AT TIME OF INSPECTION). PIC CONFIRMED THE STEAM TABLES ARE USED FOR SELF-SERVICE BUFFETS.
violations.corrective_action: PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THE STEAM TABLE WILL EITHER NEED TO BE MOVED BACK TO THE BACK KITCHEN OR A SNEEZE GUARD WILL NEED TO BE INSTALLED TO PROTECT THE FOOD. PIC AGREED TO NOT USE THE STEAM TABLES FOR THE TIME-BEING. PLEASE ENSURE A DECISION IS MADE REGARDING THE BUFFET TABLES BY FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION ON OCTOBER 8TH.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED CONTAINERS OF DOUGH STORED ON THE GROUND IN THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOOD ITEMS SHOULD ALWAYS BE ELEVATED 6 INCHES OFF THE GROUND TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING. PLEASE ENUSRE CORRECTION AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED GRIME/DEBRIS BUILD-UP IN CERTAIN AREAS (NEAR COOK-LINE, SHELVING, THREE-VAT SINK AREA) IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: PLEASE ENSURE THE KITCHEN IS CLEANED ON A MORE FREQUENT BASIS TO PREVENT GRIME ACCUMULATION.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH HANDS AT THREE-COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE. PLEASE REVIEW PROPER HANDWASHING PROCEDURES WITH STAFF.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED NO HANDWASHING SINKS WITH SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC A COPY OF HANDWASHING SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED. PLEASE ENSURE SIGNAGE IS POSTED AT ALL HANDWASHING SINKS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED ABOVE VARIOUS DRINKS AND RAW CHICKEN ABOVE PRODUCE IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION AND PROPER RAW ORGANIZATION WAS DISCUSSED. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED RICE AT 129- 131F AND COOKED CAULIFLOWER AT 117-125F IN THE 1-DOOR HOTBOX (WHICH WAS TURNED OFF); OBSERVED SAMBAR AT 109F, CASHEW CURRY AT 111-120F, VEGETABLE FRITTERS AT 87-90F, AND CHICKEN AT 89F IN THE STEAM TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS REVIEWED PROPER HOT HOLDING PARAMETERS WITH THE PIC; PIC UNDERSTANDS HOT HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE. FOOD WAS EITHER REHEATED OR WOULD BE THROWN AWAY WITHIN 4 HOURS OF WHEN THE FOOD FINISHED COOKING. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS IN STEAM TABLE ARE NOT DOUBLE PANNED AND ARE FULLY INSIDE THE STEAM TABLE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED VEGETABLE BIRYANI AT 45F, MANGO LASSI AT 45F, PANEER AT 45F, CHICKEN BIRYANI AT 47F, COOKED GOAT AT 48F, RAITA AT 52F, MILK AT 45F, AND VEGETABLE CURRY AT 50F IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Food Packaged, Label Information
violations.observation: Insufficient information is provided on the label of the following food items packaged in the food establishment: OBSERVED VARIOUS DRY SNACKS IN TO- GO CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: Food packaged in a food establishment for customer self service shall include labels that contain the following information: 1. the common name of the food, 2. the list of major ingredients including artificial colors or preservatives, 3. the total net weight or quantity of the food, 4. the name and place of business of the food manufacturer, packer, or distributor, 5. the name of the food source for each major food allergen contained in the food,6. nutrition labeling and, 7. for any salmonid fish containing canthaxanthin as a color additive, the labeling of the bulk fish container, including a list of ingredients, displayed on the retail container or by other written means. PIC WILL DISCONTINUE SELLING DRY FOODS FOR RETAIL SALE UNTIL THE FACILITY CAN PROPERLY LABEL FOODS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED WALK-IN COOLER AT 43F-47F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED/MOVED TCS FOODS TO ANOTHER COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PIC CALLED A REPAIR TECHNICIAN DURING INSPECTION TO COME REPAIR THE COOLER THE SAME DAY. PLEASE PROVIDE REPAIR INVOICE TO EHS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
